title: MADDIE: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Engine
abstract: arXiv:2610.16975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. translated_title: MADDIE：多智能体药物发现引擎
translated_abstract: 药物发现仍然是一个资源密集且耗时的过程，一款药物从研发到上市需要数十亿美元的投入和长达十年的开发周期。尽管许多计算机模拟工具已经加速了这一过程，但操作这些工具仍然需要药物化学家投入大量的时间、精力和专业知识。基于大语言模型构建的自主系统已成为一种有前景的解决方案，然而当前的设计限制了其性能。现有的单智能体系统在应对长周期、多步骤的现实任务时扩展性较差，而多智能体系统通常执行预定义的工作流程，无法捕捉真实药物发现活动中迭代、非线性的本质。在本文中，我们提出了MADDIE，一个多智能体药物发现引擎。它由一个中央智能体——Orchestrator（协调器）和四个专门的工作智能体组成：HitIdentifier（命中物识别器）、LeadOptimizer（先导物优化器）、Synthesizer（合成器）和Evaluator（评估器），每个智能体代表药物发现过程中的一个关键步骤。
tldr: 提出了MADDIE多智能体药物发现引擎，通过中央协调器与四个专业化智能体的动态协作，克服了单智能体系统扩展性差以及传统多智能体系统预定义工作流无法适应药物发现迭代非线性本质的局限。
en_tdlr: MADDIE is a multi-agent drug discovery engine featuring a central Orchestrator and four specialized worker agents that dynamically collaborate, overcoming the poor scalability of single-agent systems and the rigid predefined workflows of conventional multi-agent systems in realistic, iterative drug discovery campaigns.
